fp_zero_edge_per_lineage_lane.note: versions independent within a world (an upper bound); A: at most 2 Validation tries a lineage; B: tries until a pass, 3 failed looks or 2 failed Validations

rule: DSCREEN-2 (screen D2, direction lane). Per program, at 1.0x costs: PRE-CHECK on the Validation window: at least 50 trades, at least 25 entry days, mean entry-day return > 0. After the sealed-holdout look: the pooled entry-day t (mean / sd(ddof 1) x sqrt(n)) over the Validation and holdout entry days >= c, AND holdout P&L > 0. c is calibrated so that the lane's pass rate at zero edge is 10% on worlds built from 2017-19 blocks only (each program centred on its 2017-19 mean), then rounded up to 0.01. ADOPT D2 only if ALL hold, each pool-A condition on BOTH measurement world sets (mixed 2017-19/2022-24 worlds centred on the six-year mean, MONEY's construction; and 2022-24-block worlds centred on the 2022-24 mean): (1) lane FP at zero edge, 95% world-bootstrap upper bound <= 12%; (2) all eligible census cells' FP at zero edge, 95% world-bootstrap upper bound <= 12%; (3) the swarm placebo programs' FP at zero edge (2022-24 worlds) <= 10%; (4) lane power at +10% of max loss a trade >= 9.7% (3 x S-C's 3.22%). Otherwise S-C stays. Cluster-bootstrap intervals are reported beside, not decision inputs. Lane = 0.20/0.30-delta calls held 5 or 8 sessions; 2,000 worlds a set; 1,000 bootstrap resamples.
